declared difference (issue #1035 cache-nofinger): no row beyond the old ones when every rc/ reference to the
servlet's paths carries ?v= (any position, v, ver or version), is waived with a reason in a comment of the
file's syntax, belongs to another mount or to the station's /module/ and /file/, or sits in rc/vendor or
rc/ext; the unfingerprinted max-age (line 4) keeps its old row and the gated one (line 7) stays clean.

-- m/BDash.java --
class BDash extends BWebServlet {
  public String getServletName() { return "dash"; }
  void doGet(WebOp op) {
    rsp.setHeader("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
  }
  void asset(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse rsp) {
    rsp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("v") != null ? "public, max-age=3600" : "no-cache");
  }
}
